The '''Ciutric sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], it hosted the newly proclaimed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Ciutric Offensive]] for to eradicate vestigial [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] forces.

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Tiroc Vhon]] escorted the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kubariet]] out of the sector after rescuing him during the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of New Holgha|attack]] on [[New Holgha]].<ref name="BoFettPracMan" />
